title: Sport Motorcycle
description: A complete supersport machine emitted from one steering-geometry contract: a slot-tagged mesh writer, revolved wheels with tangentially varying spoke arms, a rotor alpha mask, an upright-frame twin-spar rail, bore-local engine volumes, superellipse bodywork with real panel shells, a hanging chain, and a signed-volume orientation guard.
techniques: steering-axis placement of every front-end part from rake and triple offset
semantic mesh writer with per-part material slots
thick panel shells with authored rim thickness
superellipse bodywork sections with exponent-carried creases
petal rotor alpha mask and spoke-arm lofts
